title: SWF: Metadata XMP tag (tag 77)
description: SWF tag 77 (Metadata) carries XMP metadata as an XML string. When CompileOptions includes metadata: {title, description, author}, emit tag 77 after FileAttributes. Body is a UTF-8 XMP XML string (no null terminator). Build the XMP XML using template string. Add unit tests verifying tag 77 appears and contains the expected strings when metadata option is set.
